from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str

@app.post("/items/")
def create_item(item: Item):
    return item

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_validation_error_schema():
    response = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    schema = response.json()
    validation_error = schema["components"]["schemas"]["ValidationError"]
    
    assert "input" in validation_error["properties"]
    assert "ctx" in validation_error["properties"]
    assert validation_error["properties"]["input"]["title"] == "Input"
    assert validation_error["properties"]["ctx"]["title"] == "Context"
    assert validation_error["properties"]["ctx"]["type"] == "object"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_openapi_validation_error_schema()
        print("Verification successful!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Verification failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
